notes: Time handling and entry safety. The app now uses one clock for everything: broker server time is converted to UTC internally, so trading decisions no longer mix the two. This also corrects the cooldown countdown in the activity log, which could be several hours wrong depending on your broker. New safety checks run immediately before every order: the symbol must be tradable, the price quote must be fresh, and the price must not have drifted more than 2x ATR away from the level the signal was based on, so the bot no longer chases a move that ran away after the signal. These checks are deliberately generous and should not block normal entries. Times are shown in local time for display only.
